## Compute $\operatorname{Pic}(\mathbb{P}^n \times \mathbb{C}^*)$

**Setup.** View $\mathbb{C}^* = \mathbb{P}^1 \setminus \{0, \infty\}$ as a Zariski-open subset of $\mathbb{P}^1$. Then
$$U := \mathbb{P}^n \times \mathbb{C}^* \subset X := \mathbb{P}^n \times \mathbb{P}^1$$
is the complement of the two divisors
$$D_0 := \mathbb{P}^n \times \{0\}, \qquad D_\infty := \mathbb{P}^n \times \{\infty\}.$$

**Picard group of the ambient space.** Since $\mathbb{P}^n$ and $\mathbb{P}^1$ are smooth projective with $H^1(\mathcal{O})=0$, the Künneth formula for line bundles gives
$$\operatorname{Pic}(\mathbb{P}^n \times \mathbb{P}^1) \cong \operatorname{Pic}(\mathbb{P}^n) \oplus \operatorname{Pic}(\mathbb{P}^1) \cong \mathbb{Z} \oplus \mathbb{Z},$$
generated by $\mathcal{O}(1,0) = p_1^*\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^n}(1)$ and $\mathcal{O}(0,1) = p_2^*\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(1)$. Under this identification the class of $D_0$ is $(0,1)$ and the class of $D_\infty$ is $(0,1)$.

**Exact sequence for the open subset.** For a smooth variety $X$ and open $U = X \setminus \bigcup D_i$ with $D_i$ irreducible divisors, there is the standard exact sequence
$$\bigoplus_i \mathbb{Z}[D_i] \xrightarrow{\;\rho\;} \operatorname{Pic}(X) \longrightarrow \operatorname{Pic}(U) \longrightarrow 0,$$
where $\rho([D_i]) = [\mathcal{O}_X(D_i)]$ is the class of $D_i$ in $\operatorname{Pic}(X)$.

Here the map is
$$\rho(a[D_0] + b[D_\infty]) = (a+b)(0,1) \in \mathbb{Z}\oplus\mathbb{Z}.$$
Its image is the subgroup $\{0\}\oplus\mathbb{Z} = \langle (0,1)\rangle$.

**Conclusion.** Therefore
$$\operatorname{Pic}(\mathbb{P}^n \times \mathbb{C}^*) \cong \frac{\mathbb{Z}\oplus\mathbb{Z}}{\langle(0,1)\rangle} \cong \mathbb{Z},$$
generated by the restriction (pullback via the projection $p_1: U \to \mathbb{P}^n$) of $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^n}(1)$, i.e. by $\mathcal{O}(1,0)|_U$.

**Sanity check via the product formula.** The general decomposition for smooth varieties over $\mathbb{C}$ is
$$\operatorname{Pic}(X\times Y) \cong \operatorname{Pic}(X)\oplus \operatorname{Pic}(Y)\oplus \operatorname{Hom}(\operatorname{Alb}(X),\operatorname{Pic}^0(Y)).$$
We have $\operatorname{Pic}(\mathbb{P}^n)\cong\mathbb{Z}$, $\operatorname{Alb}(\mathbb{P}^n)=0$ (since $H^1(\mathbb{P}^n,\mathbb{Z})=0$), and $\operatorname{Pic}(\mathbb{C}^*)=0$ because $\mathbb{C}^*=\operatorname{Spec}\mathbb{C}[t,t^{-1}]$ is the spectrum of a UFD. The formula gives $\mathbb{Z}\oplus 0\oplus 0 = \mathbb{Z}$, agreeing with the divisor computation above.

$$\boxed{\operatorname{Pic}(\mathbb{P}^n \times \mathbb{C}^*) \cong \mathbb{Z}, \text{ generated by } p_1^*\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^n}(1).}$$
